<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import { variants } from "../../utils";

  /** TableHeadCell: the classes of each value of each prop (shadcn/cva style). */
  export const tableHeadCellVariants = variants({
    base: "px-2 py-2 text-left align-middle font-semibold",
    variants: {},
    defaultVariants: {},
  });

  export type TableHeadCellProps = {
    scope?: string;
    colspan?: number;
    rowspan?: number;
    abbr?: string;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { cn } from "../../utils";
  import { isSetNum, oneOfOrLower, orUndef } from "../../utils/expr";

  let {
    scope,
    colspan: colSpan,
    rowspan: rowSpan,
    abbr,
    class: className,
    children,
    ...rest
  }: TableHeadCellProps = $props();

  const cls = $derived(cn(tableHeadCellVariants(), className));
</script>

<th
  {...(cls ? { class: cls } : {})}
  {...({ "scope": orUndef(oneOfOrLower(scope, "", "col", "colgroup", "row", "rowgroup")) } as Record<string, unknown>)}
  abbr={orUndef(abbr)}
  {...({ "colspan": isSetNum(colSpan) ? String(colSpan ?? 0) : undefined } as Record<string, unknown>)}
  {...({ "rowspan": isSetNum(rowSpan) ? String(rowSpan ?? 0) : undefined } as Record<string, unknown>)}
  {...rest}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</th>
